cohort: A total of 67 preterm neonatal pigs delivered by cesarean on day 105 of 115 (analogous to 30 weeks gestation in humans).
finding: Enteral and intravenous supplementation of arginine and citrulline did not impact the incidence or severity of Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) in preterm neonatal pigs, indicating these are not feasible or safe nutrition strategies for NEC prevention.
gest_age: 105 days of 115 (analogous to 30 weeks gestation in humans)
